leadId.description: Existing lead's opaque ID.

campaign.description: One campaign name or ID; all is reserved for batch-update-lead-statuses.

memberEmail.description: Member on whose behalf SUBSCRIBED is applied; omission uses workspace owner. Only valid with SUBSCRIBED.

requestedBy.description: Who requested the status change; if omitted the provider's attribution default applies.

reason.description: Reason the lead was not updated, when supplied.

status.description: Resulting lead status reported by the provider.

updated.description: Whether this lead was updated in this campaign.

campaign.description: Campaign name reported by the provider.

items.description: A campaign outcome reported by the provider for the selected lead.

functions.name: upsert-lead
functions.description: Create a lead or update an existing lead, optionally adding it to an audience. Identifier-based matching follows the workspace's duplicate merge setting; it is not an atomic unique-key upsert.

bio.description: Profile biography; empty text is ignored, not a clearing instruction.

note.description: Nonempty text replaces the existing profile note; omission or empty text keeps it.

crmId.description: Contact identifier in the CRM connected to this workspace.

phone.description: Phone number as text, preserving prefixes and formatting.

gender.description: Provider-supported gender value; omit if not known.

leadId.description: Existing lead ID; when supplied, only that lead is updated and a missing lead fails.

twitter.description: Twitter identifier in the form recognized by the workspace.

audience.description: Audience name or ID; an unmatched value creates an audience with that name. Omit to avoid assigning an audience.

lastName.description: Family name used in name-and-company matching.

firstName.description: Given name; name-based identification also requires lastName and companyName or companyUrl.

companyUrl.description: Employer website; also usable with firstName and lastName to identify a lead.

companyName.description: Employer name; also usable with firstName and lastName to identify a lead.

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn profile URL, also usable as a matching identifier.

personalEmail.description: Personal email, also usable as a matching identifier.

enrichmentData.description: Existing enrichment results keyed by provider field name; does not start enrichment.

date.description: Opaque numeric enrichment date metadata; units are unspecified and no timestamp conversion is applied.

found.description: Found value in its original scalar type, or null when no value is supplied.

status.description: Provider enrichment status for this field.

additionalProperties.description: Existing enrichment result for a provider field.

relationsCount.description: LinkedIn relationship count; zero is ignored by the provider.

customAttributes.description: Custom attribute values keyed by slot number 1 through 20; empty values are ignored.

enrichmentStatus.description: Existing enrichment status to store, without triggering enrichment.

professionalEmail.description: Professional email, also usable as a matching identifier.

excludeContactedLeads.description: If true, ignore leads already contacted in any campaign without creating or updating them.

FunctionInput_lagrowthmachine_upsertlead.description: Lead identifiers and optional profile changes, enrichment results, and additive audience assignment.

id.description: Created, updated, or matched lead ID; omitted when the provider skips the lead and supplies no ID.

message.description: Provider explanation of the lead and audience outcome, including merge, ignore, or skip decisions.

tags.instructions: Use when importing a lead or applying profile changes with identifiers you already have. Use `get-lead` for a known lead ID and `search-lead` to resolve other identifiers first.
